subject.title: Support Workers AI model selection during onboard

question: Should the bundled Cloudflare provider own first-class Workers AI model routing, or should Workers AI use the generic custom-provider onboarding contract?
rationale: Both approaches are technically available, but they establish different supported endpoint, model-catalog, credential, and upgrade contracts; source inspection cannot choose that product boundary safely.

options.title: First-class Cloudflare mode
options.body: Add a provider-owned Workers AI/REST mode with explicit model selection and one canonical config builder across onboarding and catalog paths.

options.title: Canonical custom-provider flow
options.body: Keep the bundled provider Anthropic-focused and document and test the exact generic non-interactive setup for Workers AI.

recommendation.title: First-class Cloudflare mode
recommendation.body: Add a provider-owned Workers AI/REST mode with explicit model selection and one canonical config builder across onboarding and catalog paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The landed provider introduction and plugin-boundary onboarding refactor are the strongest available history signals for this contract decision.
